title: Power Amplifier
text: 对带记忆的功率放大器进行建模；按 {Coefficient Matrix} 指定系数矩阵；{Model} 指定模型类型 Memory、{Measured interval of PA data (s)} 指定输入-输出数据的采样间隔 1e-6、{Rin (ohm)} 指定输入电阻、{Rout (ohm)} 输出电阻、{Ground and hide negative terminals} 指定 RF 电路端子接地，按实例取值。

params.name: Model
params.values: 模型类型 Memory polynomial (default) | Generalized Hammerstein | Cross-Term Memory | Cross-Term Hammerstein

params.name: Coefficient Matrix
params.values: 系数矩阵 1 (default) | complex matrix | real matrix

params.name: Measured interval of PA data (s)
params.values: 输入-输出数据的采样间隔 1e-6 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Rin (ohm)
params.values: 输入电阻 50 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Rout (ohm)
params.values: 输出电阻 50 (default) | real positive scalar

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: RF 电路端子接地 on (default) | off
